title: Lane X2 Release: Rig-Governed Internal MLX-Backed Local Runtime Boundary
summary: Implemented the first real internal Rig-governed local inference runtime. Uses mlx-lm Python APIs directly under Rig Relay governance — not an external endpoint adapter. The RiggedLocalRuntimeBoundary provides typed application-service APIs for MLX-backed model loading, governed inference, model inventory, content-light evidence, cache privacy policy, honest capability reporting, and tool-call output governance. OMLX was studied as an Apache-2.0 reference implementation; architectural patterns (model classification taxonomy, cache evidence metrics schema, capability probe structure, MLX thread safety) were adapted with attribution. Nine production dependencies added under justified Apache 2.0 compatibility. All dependencies are permissively licensed (MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD). No OMLX source code was directly copied. No OMLX engine, scheduler, cache, or server code was ported. Continuous batching, KV cache persistence, embeddings, reranking, VLM/OCR, and streaming governance are explicitly deferred.
x2_1_summary: X2.1 fixes all 8 blocking findings: visible model output (LocalInferenceResponse), durable JSONL evidence ledgers, private-context policy (local runtime can process private repo content), real tool-call parsing (JSON blocks, function-call tags, tool-call XML), corrected thread-safety documentation, chat-template-based prompt formatting, real Apple Silicon execution proof (Qwen3-0.6B-4bit: 15+30 tokens, 1548ms), and v1 posture correction (embeddings/reranking/VLM/cache now v1_required_pending_implementation). 33/33 tests passing.

telemetry_and_redaction_implications: Runtime evidence emission uses content-light logger.debug(). No raw prompts, completions, or model output in any evidence. SHA256 hashes for all content-derived references. Future wire-up to local observability JSONL requires registering event names in EventName enum.

dependency_changes.justification: All required for MLX-backed internal runtime using mlx-lm.load() and mlx-lm.generate(). All permissively licensed. No copyleft dependencies. Platform-constrained to Apple Silicon for local inference; Rig Relay remains cross-platform for cloud providers.

released_boundary: RiggedLocalRuntimeBoundary: an internal MLX-backed governed local inference runtime, informed by and legally compatible with OMLX's Apache-2.0 reference architecture, that preserves Rig Relay authority over privacy, task admission, tool execution, evidence, and UI projection while providing real model loading, governed inference, model inventory, and typed execution evidence for future Inference Studio consumption.
stated_consumer_purpose: A later X0/X2 integration milestone wires Inference Studio to a real Rig-governed local runtime (MLX-backed model loading and inference under Rig admission/evidence/tool authority) rather than an external endpoint placeholder.
freeze_condition: This lane freezes upon remote verification of published architecture decision, implementation, tests, dependency changes, and license compliance artifacts. Reopens only for: a concrete defect inside the released boundary, a named X0/X2 integration milestone consuming this boundary, or a user-directed architectural revision.
